jobs.title: Founding engineer- Mo team (AI Health Companion)
jobs.descriptionHtml: 🤖 WHO WE ARE We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone. We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are bui … We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care. … You’ll work at the intersection of product engineering, ML engineering, and medical expertise.
